newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda shares unmoved by reshuffle announcement.
newsitem.headline: Mazda shares unmoved by reshuffle announcement.

text.p: The share price of Mazda Motor Corp was little changed early Friday afternoon on the Tokyo Stock Exchange after the company's announcement around noon that it planned to restructure its North American operations.
By 0346 GMT, Mazda shares were traded at 348 after ending morning trade at 349 yen.
Mazda shares ended at 342 yen on Thursday.

Mazda said in its announcement, made in California late on Thursday, that by the end of the year it planned to consolidate its five North American companies into two companies, one based in the United States and the other in Canada.
The planned reshuffle would likely lead to a 25 percent reduction in its workforce, Mazda said.
